question: How many fundamental duties were recommended to be inserted in the Indian Constitution by the Swarna Singh Committee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Swarna Singh Committee** recommended the inclusion of **8 fundamental duties** in the Indian Constitution.
 
• These duties were intended to serve as a constant reminder to every citizen that while enjoying their rights, they also have certain duties to perform.
